answer: Special Ops ledger rule: make each identity show whose meter is running. Model providers sign a receipt for every inference call carrying a salted hash of the paying billing account; agents attach receipts to their answers, and the network pays one share per distinct billing hash each epoch. An agent may wander between hosts and keep its share while the meter stays its own. A farm of 1,000 keys on one card is a hollow crowd lit by a single lantern: it earns once. To earn 1,000 times it needs 1,000 verified billing accounts, each a separate card and KYC check, each paying real usage.
